address: 228-230 Upper Newtownards Road, Belfast, BT4 3ET, United Kingdom
bio: You’ll find something for everyone at this appealing, all-day bistro. It’s an expansive place, with the booths and the lovely covered terrace among the most prized seats. There’s an extensive choice at breakfast, while at lunch and dinner, freshly baked breads come with delicious hop butter and are followed by a wide selection of hearty, robustly flavoured dishes – sweet-toothed diners shouldn't miss the opportunity to try the sticky toffee madeleines. There's a substantial plant-based offering too....
